meta.name: Noumaan
meta.title: Backend Journey
meta.tagline: Finish the Next.js essentials, then Node, Express and MongoDB, then ship a full-stack project. One page, every date.

phases.name: Next.js essentials only
phases.goal: Finish the 6 items that matter, then stop. 25 of 48 done is enough to build with.
phases.deliverable: Next.js app deployed on Vercel with env vars
phases.tip: Parked for later: CSS Modules, SCSS, i18n, Edge runtime, Middleware, Rewrites, Husky, Lint-Staged.

tasks.title: error.js, nested error handling, global-error (26, 27, 28, 30)
Tailwind v4 setup + adding it to an existing project (34, 35)
next/image optimization + environment variables (36, 38)
Prepare and deploy to Vercel with env vars (37). Then close the Next.js tab.

phases.name: Node + Express core
phases.goal: Understand how a server works, not just copy routes.
phases.tip: Watch the video in 30–40 min chunks, pause, then code it again from a blank file.

tasks.title: HTTP, status codes, REST, JSON, Postman. Node runtime, modules, npm, fs, path
Async JS: promises, async/await, event loop. Small scripts without the video
Express: routing, req/res, params, query, body parsing
Middleware, express.Router, MVC folders, dotenv, nodemon
Mini project: Notes API (in-memory, then JSON file). No tutorial for this one

phases.name: MongoDB + Mongoose
phases.goal: Model data properly and build a real CRUD API.
phases.deliverable: Struvia API with your Redux frontend connected
phases.tip: Reusing Struvia gives you a real frontend to test against.

tasks.title: Documents, collections, Atlas free cluster, Compass, CRUD in the shell
Mongoose schemas, models, CRUD through Express
Validation (Zod), refs + populate, indexes, pagination, filtering, sorting
PROJECT 1: backend for your Struvia tracker. Connect your Redux frontend to it

phases.name: Auth + production habits
phases.goal: The part most tutorials skip and interviewers ask about.
phases.deliverable: Job Tracker API live on Render + Atlas
phases.tip: Never store plain passwords, never commit .env, never trust req.body.

tasks.title: bcrypt, JWT, httpOnly cookies, login/register/logout
Auth middleware, protected routes, role-based access
Central error handler, async wrapper, status codes, logging basics
helmet, cors, rate limiting, sanitizing. File upload: multer + Cloudinary
PROJECT 2: Job Tracker API with auth, deployed on Render + Atlas

phases.name: Full-stack capstone
phases.goal: One polished Next.js + Express + MongoDB app, live and documented.
phases.deliverable: Capstone live, with README, Postman collection, demo
phases.tip: Ship something small and finished before adding features.

tasks.title: Connect Next.js to your API: CORS, cookies, protected pages
PROJECT 3: Resume Builder v2 or an Edu-Devora backend. Real auth, real data
Deploy: Vercel + Render + Atlas. Fix production bugs
README with screenshots, API docs, Postman collection, 2-min demo

phases.name: Polish + apply
phases.deliverable: Tests added, repos cleaned, 10+ applications sent

tasks.title: Basic tests: Jest + Supertest on auth and one CRUD route
ESLint + Prettier on all repos (from your parked list)
Update resume, LinkedIn, pinned GitHub repos with the 3 backend projects
Apply daily, 10+ targeted applications. Keep DSA going

parallel.name: DSA in JavaScript
parallel.intro: 45–60 min every evening from Nov 1. Patterns over volume.

details.label: Rule
details.text: Understand the pattern, then solve 2–3 easy to medium problems. Do not grind.

items.title: Two pointers, sliding window, prefix sums
Revisit weak topics, 2 timed mocks a week

projects.title: Project 1 · Struvia API
projects.text: Projects, tasks, status, filters. Mongoose + Zod, wired to your Redux frontend.

projects.title: Project 2 · Job Tracker API
projects.text: Auth, protected routes, applications, status. Live on Render.

projects.title: Project 3 · Capstone
projects.text: Next.js + Express + Mongo. Real auth, docs, demo video.

notes.title: Daily rhythm
notes.text: Morning 2h learn. Afternoon 2h build. Evening 1h DSA. Last hour: notes + revise.

notes.title: Video verdict
notes.text: Good for fundamentals. Auth, security and deployment need docs + your own projects.

notes.title: No tutorial hopping
notes.text: One video, one docs set per topic. Finish a section, then build.

notes.title: DSA: yes, lightly
notes.text: Helps fresher screening. JavaScript, 45–60 min/day, easy to medium.

notes.title: Next.js rule
notes.text: Finish Phase 0 first. What is left is parked, not failed.

notes.title: Git habit
notes.text: Commit daily. Your GitHub graph is part of the resume.

notes.title: Sunday review
notes.text: Tick progress. List 3 things you did not get. Fix those first.

notes.title: Cut rule
notes.text: Phase over by 3 days? Cut scope, never push the next phase.

notes.title: Buffer
notes.text: Sunday evening is free. Catch up, do not start new topics.
